name: iam:PassRole + codebuild:CreateProject + codebuild:StartBuildBatch
description: Create a CodeBuild project configured for batch builds with a privileged role, then start a build batch to execute malicious buildspec commands with that role's permissions. This variation uses codebuild:StartBuildBatch instead of codebuild:StartBuild.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must trust codebuild.amazonaws.com

additional.description: Discover roles trusting CodeBuild for auto-discovery
Clean up created project (gained after escalation)

admin: IAM role with administrative permissions and trust policy allowing codebuild.amazonaws.com
lateral: IAM role with any permissions and trust policy allowing codebuild.amazonaws.com

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the CodeBuild project (must trust codebuild.amazonaws.com) [auto]

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach AdministratorAccess to (auto-resolved from caller identity if not set)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for CodeBuild project deployment

options.name: PROJECT_NAME
options.description: Name of the CodeBuild project to create

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete the CodeBuild project after execution (uses escalated privileges gained by the payload)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess (or any managed policy) to an IAM user or role via CodeBuild buildspec
